name: MCP Enhanced Data Retrieval System
description: Enables AI applications to access and contextualize organizational knowledge sources including GitHub repositories and internal documentation through standardized MCP protocol integration. Features OAuth 2.1 authentication, vector-based semantic search, and optimized context chunking for enterprise development workflows.
